data.name: ShootX
data.detailed_description:
The world is sinking into chaos. Panic reigns everywhere, and an army of X-Guards is doing everything in its power to take control of every corner of the earth. Cities are being overrun, communication networks are being crippled, and any resistance is being brutally crushed.

As a soldier in a special unit, you dive into enemy-occupied territories, infiltrate the X-Guards' bases, and destroy their camps. With haptic gunplay, tactical approaches, and clever maneuvers, you are always one step ahead. Every mission requires full commitment and quick reactions – only those who act skillfully will survive the most difficult missions.

ShootX not only offers an intense gaming experience, but also impressive graphics. Violent explosions, beautiful 3D models, and detailed environments bring the world to life. Even without the most powerful PC, enjoy smooth performance and crisp action thanks to Unreal Engine 5.

Throw yourself into intense shootouts and experience the world of ShootX. Ready to turn the tide and save the world from destruction? ShootX is waiting for you.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1400, Intel i5 6600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060, RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The storage space size may increase due to content updates
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 1600x, Intel i7 6700K
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1070, RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: The storage space size may increase due to content updates

content_descriptors.notes: The game has violence in the form of weapons and killing. The weapons and vehicles are realistic. The enemies lie on the ground after they are dead. There is NO nudity.
